Revealed Layer

This image was hidden beneath the overlay.

Circle Reveal

This entire section clips away in a circle, revealing the layer below.

xs="stack(reveal)" animate-self="reveal(circle)"

Gradient Layer

A rich gradient revealed by the inset reveal.

Inset Reveal

The top layer contracts from all edges, revealing the gradient.

xs="stack(reveal)" animate-self="reveal(inset)"

Bold Red

High-contrast section revealed via diamond clip.

Polygon Reveal

The top layer clips into a diamond, revealing the red section.

xs="stack(reveal)" animate-self="reveal(polygon)"

Teal Section

Scroll back up — the overlay returns.

Reveal + Exit

Uses the exit token — the clip-path reverses when scrolling back.

xs="stack(reveal)" animate-self="reveal(circle) exit"

Combined Effect

The container faded up while the top layer clipped away.

Reveal + Fade Up

Container fades up while the last child clips away simultaneously.

xs="stack(reveal)" animate-self="reveal(circle) fade-up() slow"

Magenta Layer

Revealed as the overlay corners morph away.

Superellipse Reveal

The top layer morphs via corner-shape + border-radius.

xs="stack(reveal)" animate-self="reveal(superellipse)"

Shape reveals

The overlay clips into a media shape — one reveal-shape keyframe, endpoints from the --shp-* catalog.

Emerald Layer

Revealed as the overlay clips into a hexagon.

Hexagon Reveal

The top layer clips into a hexagon, revealing the layer below.

xs="stack(reveal)" animate-self="reveal(hex)"

Amber Layer

A five-point star clips the overlay away.

Star Reveal

The top layer clips into a star — a 10-point polygon that morphs to the full frame.

xs="stack(reveal)" animate-self="reveal(star)"

Photo Layer

An image behind a diamond-clipped overlay.

Rhombus Reveal

The top layer clips into a rhombus (diamond), revealing the photo.

xs="stack(reveal)" animate-self="reveal(rhomb)"

Rose Layer

Scroll back up — the overlay returns.

Plus Reveal + Exit

A cross/plus clip with the exit token — reverses on scroll-back.

xs="stack(reveal)" animate-self="reveal(plus) exit"

Indigo Layer

A clean circular reveal from the shared catalog.

Circle Reveal (shape)

Uses the reveal-tuned --shp-circle pair (0%→100%), distinct from media="shp(circle)".

xs="stack(reveal)" animate-self="reveal(circ)"

End of demos
